notes.title: College Bound Episode 3 - new DLC!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The College Bound saga continues with Episode 3![/b][/h1]

[h2]DLC will launch on [b]January 28 2022 @ 10:00am PST[/b].[/h2]

Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850990/College_Bound__Episode_3/]here[/url] to head over to the DLC's store page, wishlist it and download as soon as it is available. When released, the price of the DLC will be 9.99 USD, and it will be adjusted for specified countries.

[h3]Description of the Episode:[/h3]
College life can be a grind at times and an absolute blast at other times. Whether in the classroom or outside of it, Episode 3 gives our hero a number of new avenues to explore. The "[i]Party of the Century[/i]" kicks things off. Sure, it's hard for any party live up to that kind of billing, but it does open up a few doors - both good and bad - that the player may choose to step through...or not. Should you have some sexy fun with friend and foe alike, or should you stay true to your girlfriend? The choice is yours, but either way, be prepared to [b]deal with the consequences[/b] - positive and negative.

The fun isn't limited to just your time at the university, either! You run into a wide [b]variety of MILFs[/b] in your day to day activities, ranging from your sexy landlady to your beautiful boss. You also discover that all the cutest girls your age aren't just at your school - you run into them all over town. Of course, only you can determine whether a free-wheeling lifestyle or allegiance to your one true love is the way to go. Being the stud that you are, there are [b]temptations at every turn.[/b] 

What will you do? How will you choose to live your life? Will you be on the side of lawful good, or chaotic evil? OK, OK, this isn't that kind of game, but still, whether to live a moral, reserved life or something a bit more on the wild side is entirely up to you.

[b]Try College Bound Episode 3 today, and live how you want to live![/b]

[i]Note: the game was tested and I've tried my best to provide you the best experience, but if you encounter any bug, use this form to submit a bug report so I can investigate the issue. [url=https://forms.gle/bohNxUYEEXe1m7sv7]Bug report link.[/url][/i]

Link to the Steam store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850990/College_Bound__Episode_3/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850990/College_Bound__Episode_3/[/url]

notes.title: College Bound Wishes You Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
Hey,

after about two months of listening to [i]All I Want For Christmas Is You[/i] by Mariah Carey in shopping malls, time for Christmas wishes has finally come.


We're getting close to an anniversary of College Bound's first release, and in this time we've managed to build a huge community of friendly and awesome people. No doubt that 2021 was a tough time because of the pandemic for all of us, but working on College Bound and your support enabled me to do something I really like, and hopefully, the game brought you a lot of joy as well. Thank you very much for all the support and kind words!


Quick note about current Steam release schedule:
- Episode 3 will be published on January 10th if everything goes according to the plan (that is, if Steam won't require me to change anything in game). Update patch will fix the remaining couple of achievements.

- I've been working on a special spin-off title for the past couple of months, more info soon! It's going to be a lot of fun, trust me. It will be published on Steam somewhere in the beginning of February. Follow me on Steam to stay up to date with the news.



[b]Merry Christmas and a wonderful New Year! [/b]

- FOZ

Here's a fun little Christmas quote:

[i]"You can tell a lot about a person by the way they handle three things: a rainy day, lost luggage, and tangled Christmas tree lights."[/i] ~ Maya Angelou

notes.title: College Bound - Episode 2 DLC Premiere
notes.content:
[b]Get ready to continue your College Bound adventure! [/b]

Episode 2 DLC will be available for free on September 17 (Friday) at 1:00 PM PDT.

College Bound is back with another episode full of crazy college adventures! Meet new characters, discover new secrets, see new hot scenes... heck, you can even [i]play Blackjack[/i]! 

Added over [b]1500 images, numerous animations, a couple of music tracks and something you'll probably like the most... 51 new achievements to unlock.[/b] Compared to Episode 1, the rendering quality of images and animations is greatly improved - download this free-to-play DLC to check it out yourself!

Episode 2 includes weekly updates from 0.3.7 up to 0.3.20 (inclusive).

An update of Episode 1 (automatic, free and ~40MB in size) is required to run this DLC. The update also improves the dialogues and language in Episode 1, removes every typo we found and optimizes the overall game performance.

[i]Description:[/i]
The life of a college student can be challenging - whether in the classroom or out of it. In Episode 1, you managed to find a way to convince the annoying university principal to reinstate your foreign exchange program scholarship. Even so, there's more to that situation than meets the eye, and it would be in your best interests to get to the bottom of that and avoid any surprises. Along the way, you meet lots of new, interesting people, some whose interests align with yours, and others that don't. You must navigate through each situation and make the right decisions to make sure that everything works out for the best. Some ominous clouds appear on the horizon, and with your usual aplomb, you must determine the best way forward for all involved. For a young man such as yourself, the opportunities that open up to you in this gorgeous, interactive game world are rather expansive. It's up to you to decide where they will take you.

I hope you'll enjoy this Episode as much as (or even more than) the first one!

Cheers,
- FOZ
